content:
jack_finance: Heads up — got an ACH return for INV-2026-348 (OrionEdge) amount $12,450. Bank code R29 (insufficient funds). Link: https://pay.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-348
maria_billing: ugh. Do we have an automatic retry policy for R29?
sam_ops: webhook payload attached: ```json
{ "return_code": "R29", "orig_amount": 12450, "tx_id": "ach_98765", "timestamp": "2026-03-01T15:10:22Z" }
```
jack_finance: Customer replied to billing email offering split payment: 50% by ACH now, 50% by card on 2026-04-05. They attached signed ACH permission (pdf).
ava_support: I asked them to confirm available bank balance and to re-send signed consent into the portal. Can we allow one manual retry + card fallback if retry fails? @jack_finance
maria_billing: prefer one retry only. if retry fails, auto-charge saved card (if present) and pause final dunning until 5 days after retry. need legal signoff on fallback.
lena_legal: ok to allow single retry and card fallback as a service exception with signed consent. use template: https://docs.redwood.com/templates/ach-consent
jack_finance: I'll call customer to verify phone consent and then queue manual retry. Logging action: MANUAL_RETRY by jack_finance at 2026-03-01T15:20Z
collections_bot: Policy update: final notice schedule paused for invoice INV-2026-348 until 2026-03-05 due to retry request.
sam_ops: ledger note queued: "ACH_RETRY_INITIATED". CSV snapshot for reconciliation: ```
account,invoice,amt,status
OrionEdge,INV-2026-348,12450,retry_initiated
```
ava_support: sent consent form link to customer and confirmed they'd approve phone confirmation. pinged them for card details if retry fails. :thumbsup:
jack_finance: called customer; they verbally authorized retry and card fallback. I posted the signed PDF to the invoice thread and scheduled retry for 2026-03-02 09:00 PST. Marking thread resolved unless retry returns. closing ts 1967890456
